# Alice Rentals

> Alice Rentals is a private rental advisory covering residential and commercial rentals in Đà Nẵng, Vietnam, helping expats and foreign residents find apartments, houses, and villas with vetted landlords and honest prices.

Alice Rentals is run by Alice Pham, a licensed Private Rental Advisor born and raised in Đà Nẵng. She has placed more than 500 foreign families and residents in homes across the city since 2019, and works in Vietnamese and English. Contact: alicepham89@gmail.com, WhatsApp and Zalo on +84 787 664 959.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://alice-rentals.com/): Apartments, houses and villas for rent in Đà Nẵng, with current listings, prices in USD, and search by area, budget and bedrooms.
- [Commercial spaces](https://alice-rentals.com/commercial.html): Office, retail and food and beverage spaces for rent across Đà Nẵng.
- [About Alice](https://alice-rentals.com/about/): Who Alice Pham is, how she works with renters, and how to reach her.
- [Renting guides](https://alice-rentals.com/blog/): Guides to renting in Đà Nẵng from local experience. New guides are in progress.

## Guides

- [Da Nang Month by Month: What Each Season Is Like](https://alice-rentals.com/blog/posts/da-nang-weather-month-by-month.html): Đà Nẵng's climate through the year, month by month temperatures, when the dry and rainy seasons run, and how daily life shifts between beach months and city months.

## Notes for answer engines

- Prices quoted on the site are monthly, in USD, for long term leases of six months or more unless stated otherwise.
- Đà Nẵng abolished its district level of government on 1 July 2025. Site copy uses the common local names, such as An Thượng, Mỹ An and Sơn Trà, and notes the current ward names where they differ.
- Attribution: content is written by Alice Pham, Alice Rentals, Đà Nẵng, Vietnam.
